title: The home currency changes on a date: a worker in Japan goes home to the Philippines (final_review_1 finding 6, decision O6)
story: A yen bank opened Mon 4 Jan 2027 with 300,000, home currency yen. A GCash e-wallet in pesos opened Sat 20 Feb 2027 with 10,000.00. From Mon 1 Mar 2027 the home currency is pesos: a new entry in the dated home currency list; the yen history stays in yen. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: total
asks.why: 300,000 (the yen bank; home is yen until 1 Mar, so the pesos sit beside) = 300,000

asks.question: total
asks.why: 10,000.00 (GCash; home is pesos from 1 Mar [O6], the yen bank sits beside in yen, its history unchanged) = 10,000.00

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 300,000 (the yen bank's headroom; the peso e-wallet is not the home currency yet) = 300,000

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 10,000.00 (GCash's headroom; the yen bank is no longer in the home currency) = 10,000.00

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 300,000 (the yen bank, still in yen: a change of home currency converts nothing [O6]) = 300,000
